quarterly_data.quarter: Micronics Japan semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (January - June 2026) results: net sales JPY 49,206 million, up 48.6%; operating income JPY 15,557 million, up 105.5%; ordinary income JPY 16,260 million, up 119.9%; net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 11,461 million, up 140.0%. Management states memory probe cards stayed strong on continued HBM demand, while R&D expenses rose year on year as it pushed technology development for the future.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 49,206 million (+48.6%); operating income JPY 15,557 million (+105.5%); net income JPY 11,461 million (+140.0%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Micronics Japan semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 Probe Card segment: sales JPY 48,542 million, up 50.8%; segment profit JPY 18,290 million, up 94.1%. Management states memory probe card sales were strong, led by DRAM, on the back of its production-capacity expansion, and a higher mix of high value-added DRAM products raised profitability. TE segment: sales JPY 664 million, down 27.9%; segment loss JPY 785 million against a JPY 268 million loss a year earlier; semiconductor test sockets sold steadily, but sales did not reach the level needed to break even and up-front development costs added to the loss.
quarterly_data.figure: Probe Card sales JPY 48,542 million (+50.8%), segment profit JPY 18,290 million (+94.1%); TE sales JPY 664 million (-27.9%), segment loss JPY 785 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Micronics Japan semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management's view of the H1 FY2026 market: demand for GPUs and other advanced logic and for HBM kept leading the semiconductor market on generative AI and cloud providers' data-center investment; because the major makers gave HBM and high value-added server products priority in their production capacity, commodity DRAM supply and demand tightened and prices kept rising; NAND flash conditions improved on growing data-center demand and supply adjustment; in non-memory, advanced-process and advanced-packaging demand was firm while automotive, industrial and consumer demand recovered unevenly, so the polarisation between AI-related and traditional uses continued.

quarterly_data.quarter: Micronics Japan semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 R&D spending was JPY 3,906 million for the group. Investing cash flow used JPY 7,505 million, mainly JPY 7,651 million for the acquisition of property, plant and equipment; machinery and vehicles (net) rose JPY 4,393 million and inventories JPY 2,267 million from the end of the prior year.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 R&D JPY 3,906 million; PP&E acquisition JPY 7,651 million
